name: Fairmont State University
academic_ranking: Fairmont State University is a public 4-year institution in Fairmont, West Virginia, offering undergraduate and graduate programs across colleges including Business & Aviation, Education, Liberal Arts, Science & Technology, and Nursing. Regionally accredited by the Higher Learning Commission. Open-to-moderately selective admissions typical of a regional public university.
financial_aid: Official 2026-27 tuition and mandatory fees: $9,080 (WV resident) / $13,710 (non-resident). Estimated total cost of attendance (on campus) ~$26,885 (resident) / ~$31,515 (non-resident). The university offers grants, loans, scholarships, and work programs via its Financial Aid office; no specific aid-recipient percentage published on the cost-of-attendance page (checked 2026-07).
facilities_notes: Fairmont State softball competes as part of the Fighting Falcons athletics program. Specific softball facility details (field name/complex) were not confirmed on the pages reviewed 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Mountain East Conference (MEC). Roster of 30 for the 2026 season.
notes: Staff directory (https://fightingfalcons.com/sports/softball/coaches) and roster page checked 2026-07-30. Coaching staff listed: Head Coach Brooke Lowery and Assistant Coach Amy Hills, plus student manager Kamron Dawson. No recruiting coordinator or graduate/volunteer assistant listed. Tuition figures from Fairmont State official cost-of-attendance page (2026-27); College Scorecard reported comparable prior-year figures ($8,708 in-state / $18,924 out-of-state). No Twitter/X handles published in the staff directory.
